messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — NVIDIA just dropped new H200 perf numbers. want a quick second opinion before we lock marketplace SKUs.

maria: can we queue a lab surge next Tue/Wed? need to run perf + quant tests across MI300 and Gaudi as well.

ken: SI needs 48h notice for integration checkpoints. we can support Tue morning best.

sasha (NVIDIA): we can open a limited lab pool Tue morning (3 systems). embargo window requested until 2026-04-15. i'll share exact driver build sha. :eyes:

alex: can someone pull the compat matrix for kernel + CUDA/rocm vs our runtime? last time a B200 microcode mismatch bit us.

maria: dropping internal link: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/hw-compat/second-opinion-drafts — matrix updated with last-run notes.

patrick: FYI our CI repro uses `run_inference --seq 2048 --batch 8` — produced a segfault on MI300 in lab run #3. snippet: ```segfault at 0x7ff... ip 0x4f2a3 stack trace...``` i'll extract a reduced repro.

liz: product needs marketplace listing copy deadlines — earliest PR window we're targeting for EMEA press is 2026-04-20. if embargo holds past that we'll need to slide the announcement.

ken: SI suggests priority order: H100/H200 first, then MI300, then Gaudi. avoids staffing overlap. objections?

sasha (NVIDIA): no objection, but need driver parity confirmation across waves. i'll DM the driver SHA.

alex: good. scheduling lab surge Tue 09:00-13:00 PST. @ken please confirm SI engineers. @patrick please prepare reduced repro for segfault and perf numbers.

patrick: will do. request snapshot of docker image hash from last run: `redwood/runtime:2026-03-15-sha256:abcd` — i'll include perf logs and flamegraphs.

deploy-bot: Scheduled lab-reservation 1777040000 for gpu-lab-2 (3 nodes) from 2026-04-06T09:00Z for 4h.

maria: added co-marketing calendar invite for EMEA press + draft announcement. tagging @liz for copy review.

liz: reviewing. if H200 in first wave we can call out 99th p95 latency numbers — need verified numbers from Patrick's run to lock claims.

alex: final asks: (1) SI confirm Tue morning (2) Patrick share reproducible segfault + perf numbers by EOD Mon (3) NVIDIA attach driver SHA in the thread/DM. i'll coordinate marketplace SKU freeze after verification.

ken: SI confirmed — 2 engineers will join Tue 09:00 PST. :thumbsup:

sasha (NVIDIA): driver SHA sent via DM. i'll also push GAUDI microcode updates after Tue tests. :rocket:

alex: thanks all — i'll post a short summary and action items after the lab run.
